content.short: Consumer finance app with banking, credit and investing.
content.description: MoneyLion is a US consumer finance super app that bundles banking, borrowing, investing, and financial content into one platform. Members get a mobile banking account and debit card with early paycheck access, cash-advance features, credit-builder loans, automated investing and crypto access, and a marketplace that recommends financial products tailored to each user. MoneyLion pairs these money tools with personalized financial education and rewards to help everyday Americans manage cash flow, build credit, and grow savings. By combining a neobank account with credit and investing in a single engagement-driven app, MoneyLion positions itself as a full financial destination rather than just a checking account, competing with other US consumer fintechs for mainstream users.
